question: On Nov. 3, 2007, Navy beat Notre Dame 46-44 in triple overtime. Before that day, how many games in a row had Navy lost to the Irish?
question_short: Navy finally beat Notre Dame on Nov. 3, 2007. How many straight losses did that snap?
answer_detail: It's an NCAA record for straight losses to one opponent. Navy's previous win over the Irish came on Nov. 2, 1963, the year Navy QB Roger Staubach won the Heisman.
answer_short: An NCAA record. Navy's last win before that came in 1963, nearly 44 years earlier.
